purpose: Teach: 名付け/生体/養護/反乱/母国/生き残っ/操縦/発酵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、社内公募で、名付けられた、いいネーミングだ。
lines.en: The new product name came from internal submissions. It's a good one.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Measured pace, clipped but not cold. A man noting competence without excess. Slight weight on 'good.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生体認証システム、社員向けに、導入予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to roll out a biometric authentication system for our staff.
lines.style: Professional briefing tone. Clear, structured delivery. Standing slightly straighter. Not hurried, but efficient — each phrase a report point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域貢献として、養護施設、長年、支援している。
lines.en: We've been supporting care facilities in the community for years. It matters to us.
lines.style: Shift to quieter conviction. Still composed but warmer now. The words carry weight because he means them. No performance, just honesty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組合の反乱、対話を通じて、回避しております。
lines.en: Yes. We've managed to work through the union concerns by staying in dialogue with them.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact update. Steady eye contact. Acknowledging difficulty without dramatising it. Small, competent pride underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 母国市場、海外展開と、両方を見据えろ。
lines.en: Keep your eyes on both markets — domestic and overseas expansion. Don't neglect either one.
lines.style: Direct instruction, the tone of someone used to being listened to. Measured but firm. Slight lean forward on the second clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。リーマンショックを生き残った企業、当社の誇りです。
lines.en: Yes. We survived the Lehman crisis. That's something we're proud of as a company.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. The voice settles on the historical fact. Not boasting — stating something earned. Breath underneath the pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経営の操縦、慎重に、行うこと、忘れるな。
lines.en: Managing operations requires care. Don't lose sight of that.
lines.style: Final, weightier instruction. Slower pace. The voice knows from experience what carelessness costs. Not threatening, but serious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。発酵食品の新事業、市場調査、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with market research on a new fermented-food division.
lines.style: Closing update. Tempo picks up slightly — forward motion. Professional but engaged, showing he's invested in the next chapter.
